definitions.explanation: a face-to-face discussion or meeting, often for evaluation, consultation, or formal discussion

notes:
USAGE:
{面談|めんだん} is a scheduled face-to-face talk in which one side advises, checks in with, or consults the other: a boss with a staff member, a teacher with a student or parent. The partner takes ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{面談|めんだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

TYPES:
- ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧{面談|めんだん} (individual meeting)
- ⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧{面談|めんだん} (parent-teacher conference)
- ⟦{進路|しんろ}→進路：14321_shinro⟧{面談|めんだん} (career guidance meeting)
- ⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧{面談|めんだん} (performance review meeting)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧: an interview that screens a candidate (job, school entrance). {面談|めんだん} is a talk, not a test; a job-hunting {面談|めんだん} is an informal meeting before any selection
- ⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧: talks between leaders or officials
- ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧: asking someone for advice, in any setting
- ミーティング: a (usually group) meeting
